correctness.rationale: Direct differentiation gives F_prime=1+4pi a B² g_rho(theta), g=cos(theta)(rho-sin(theta)); its stationary sines solve 2s²-rho s-1=0. The lower root lies (-1,0), the upper enters (0,1) exactly for rho<1; the negative lobes have one unique minimum each with depths H_minus, H_plus. Therefore the sharp first loss of strict positivity, the critical still-monotone homeomorphism, 0/1/2/3/4 zero counts including rho=0 simultaneous thresholds and rho>=1 single lobe follow. At each threshold, g second theta derivative Delta sqrt(1-nu²)>0 gives a cubic stationary inflection and square-root splitting. Expansion nu_plus=1-(1-rho)/3+... gives H_plus=(2/3)sqrt(2/3)(1-rho)^{3/2}+..., verified independently with exact symbolic stationary roots and numerical asymptotic ratio 0.9999916667. Noninjectivity alone does not imply chaos; entropy statement restricted to homeomorphism.
